capabilities: Create multiple calendars and saved Calendar or Board views over the same notes
Create and edit events as Markdown notes in a popup editor
Drag and resize calendar cards to change start and end dates
Group board cards by a Select property and drag them between columns
Define Select, Checkbox, Text, and Number properties with colors and defaults
extras: Desktop only; mobile and touch interactions are not supported. Calendar views are all-day only (no hourly schedule), and external calendar services like Google Calendar are not supported. The plugin runs locally with no network requests.
problem: Obsidian shows notes as files and lists, with no calendar or kanban-style view that renders notes as dated, property-driven cards.
summary: Property-driven calendar and board views over Markdown notes, with editable event cards, start-to-end date ranges, and multiple saved views.
